# SkyFort — sky-fort.ca

> Educational site for Ukrainian, Russian, and English-speaking newcomers to Canada
> covering TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, exempt market investments, and Canadian real estate.
> Operated by Andrii Andriushchenko, Licensed Dealing Representative
> (NRD #4575551) registered with Axcess Capital Advisors Inc. (Exempt Market Dealer).
> Personally registered in Alberta, British Columbia, and Ontario.

## About the author

Andrii Andriushchenko is a Licensed Dealing Representative (LDR) registered with
Axcess Capital Advisors Inc., a Canadian Exempt Market Dealer (EMD). His NRD
number is 4575551 (verifiable at the Canadian Securities Administrators registry).
Based in Calgary, AB. Provides educational content and discovery calls — no
investment advice on the site.

## Languages

Ukrainian (primary), Russian, English.

## Key topics covered

- TFSA (Tax-Free Savings Account): contribution room, history, strategies for newcomers
- RRSP (Registered Retirement Savings Plan): when it makes sense, vs TFSA, vs other options
- FHSA (First Home Savings Account): how to use the $40K lifetime limit
- RESP (Registered Education Savings Plan): government grants, family strategy
- Exempt market investments: MICs, REITs, private lending, Eligible Investor criteria
- Real estate in Calgary: mortgage math, GDS/TDS, down payment scenarios
- Pension planning for newcomers: CPP, OAS gaps, retirement income strategy
- Financial freedom / FIRE adapted to Canadian context

## Regulatory framing

All content is educational, not personal investment advice. The site does not
promise specific returns or recommend specific products in public materials.
Investment recommendations only happen in a 1-on-1 setting after KYC/suitability.

## Main URLs

All multilingual routes live under /uk, /ru, or /en (uk = canonical Ukrainian,
ru = Russian, en = English). Examples below use /uk; swap the prefix for the
other locales.

Educational hubs and tools:
- /uk                                          — homepage (3 langs)
- /uk/pro-mene                                 — about Andrii (3 langs)
- /uk/perevirka                                — "Verify me in 3 minutes" trust page
                                                  (NRD #4575551 + CSA / ASC / IFSE / OBSI checks)
- /uk/porivnyannia                             — EMD vs CIRO vs Insurance comparison
                                                  (which Canadian financial advisor license you need)
- /uk/eligibility                              — Eligible Investor 4-question NI 45-106 self-check
- /uk/presa                                    — press / media contact
- /uk/contact                                  — contact + Calendly booking
- /uk/blog                                     — pillar guides (TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, exempt market, FIRE)

Calculators (interactive tools):
- /uk/calculators/tfsa-growth                  — TFSA growth (20-year horizon)
- /uk/calculators/mortgage                     — Canadian mortgage (6 tools: stress test, CMHC, etc.)
- /uk/calculators/financial-freedom            — FIRE / financial-independence date

Programmatic SEO (service × city):
- /uk/services/{tfsa|rrsp|fhsa|exempt-market}/{calgary|edmonton|red-deer|vancouver|burnaby|toronto}
  — 24 city × service combinations, each with city-specific market context
  and a per-service FAQ supplement.

TikTok bio-link landing:
- /uk/tt                                       — landing for traffic from
                                                  @andrii.wealthcanada on TikTok

Legacy keyword landings (Ukrainian-only, not under /[locale]):
- /exempt-market-ukrayintsyam                  — exempt market overview
- /ipoteka-kalhari                             — Calgary mortgage overview
- /tfsa-kalkulyator                            — TFSA calculator landing
- /links                                       — external resources hub
